sites.title: 62chan
sites.description: An imageboard about the Signal on 62. Registrar offshore, moderator gone since August 2024, roughly eighteen bot posts for every human one.

sites.title: VerityAssist - Your County, Answered
sites.description: A regional AI assistant trained on public data from Verity County. It answers everything instantly and is wrong about most of it.

sites.title: AskVerity
sites.description: Questions and answers about Verity County. One of several hundred identical local Q&A sites, all moderated by the same bot.

sites.title: The Gridfall Boards
sites.description: General-purpose message board for Gridfall and the rest of Verity County.

sites.title: Verity Classifieds — Local Listings, County Wide
sites.description: The county's classifieds board, forty years old in print and six years old under its current owner. Most of it is posted from somewhere else. Some of it is a neighbour clearing out a garage.

sites.title: ClipVault
sites.description: Video uploads from around Verity County: camcorder tape, rail footage, hall shows, tool demos and radio recordings.

sites.title: Code & Coffee
sites.description: Dave Carrow writes about servers, county networking, and things he has measured in Verity County.

sites.title: VerityNet Control Panel
sites.description: Your account, your posts, installed content packs, and the sites you have authored. Local to this device.

sites.title: Verity Dash - Smart County Overview
sites.description: The Verity County smart-county dashboard. Twelve live widgets, four of which are live.

sites.title: Verity Rail Enthusiasts' Forum
sites.description: Discussion board for the Verity Rail line, its branches, and the people who photograph them.

sites.title: Gridline
sites.description: A link aggregator for Verity County, incorporated somewhere else, moderated by nobody since spring 2025.

sites.title: kestrel journal
sites.description: Jo Halloran's journal, written mostly after shifts at the Blue Kestrel diner in Gridfall.

sites.title: Verity Mail
sites.description: Your inbox. Eleven things want money, four want your attention, two are from people. The junk folder is where the machines are having the most fun.

sites.title: marla's page !!!
sites.description: Personal page belonging to Marla Kesswick of Marchfield, updated whenever she feels like it.

sites.title: ClipVault Now
sites.description: ClipVault in 2026. Nine channels serving Verity County, seven of which are not operated by anyone in Verity County.

sites.title: The Verity Ledger
sites.description: Verity County's newspaper since 1901, now a content pipeline operated by Pinelock Media Group. No reporter has worked here since 2019.

sites.title: Gridfall Pulse
sites.description: A small microblog for Gridfall and the rest of Verity County. Mostly road closures.

sites.title: ShopWell — Everything, Somehow, By Tomorrow
sites.description: A marketplace with eleven million listings and about four hundred actual products. Prices move while you look at them. Every review is five stars and none of them are about the thing you are buying.

sites.title: Verity County Amateur Astronomers
sites.description: Home page of the Verity County Amateur Astronomers, meeting monthly since 1978 and observing from Perrin Hill.

sites.title: Thomas Norris
sites.description: The page of Thomas Norris, retired Verity County surveyor, including a detailed account of the flood of June 1994.

sites.title: Verity County Services Portal
sites.description: The official services portal for Verity County. Fourteen services, four working phone numbers, and one form that requires software discontinued in 2011.

sites.title: The Verity Ledger
sites.description: The Verity County paper of record, published in Gridfall since 1901.

sites.title: The Gridfall Webring
sites.description: Hub of the Gridfall Webring, linking personal and community sites in and about Verity County.

sites.title: The Verity County Wiki
sites.description: A community-maintained wiki covering Verity County, its towns, institutions and arguments.
